outputs.location: Section titled 'Data Availability' (immediately after Methods/AIM2 PYD filament assay and before Acknowledgments)
outputs.issues: The DAS is present but not formatted according to the required template: datasets are not listed as separate bullet points; entries are written as running text. While nanobody sequences include repository (Nanosaurus), IDs and direct links, they are not presented in the required '[data type]: [repository] [accession] ([URL])' bullet format. The proteomics dataset provides repository and accession (PRIDE PXD069678) but lacks a resolvable link (e.g. identifiers.org or full PRIDE/EBI URL) and no DOI is given.
